name: user-web-client
description: Consumer service (UserWebClient) for PactJS contract testing example

scripts.pact:publish: dotenv -e .env -- pact-broker publish ./pacts/UserWebClient-UserService.json --consumer-app-version=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
scripts.pact:can-i-deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pact-broker can-i-deploy --pacticipant UserWebClient --version=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --to-environment production
scripts.pact:record-deployment: dotenv -e .env -- pact-broker record-deployment --pacticipant UserWebClient --version=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --environment=production
